description: This file defines the VoiceWakeOverlayController class, which manages a lightweight, borderless overlay panel that displays voice wake transcript information near the menu bar in a macOS application.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayController
classes.description: Main controller class for managing the voice wake overlay panel, including UI state, configuration, and internal state.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayController.Model
classes.description: A struct representing the current state of the overlay, such as displayed text, visibility, and UI level.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayController.Source
classes.description: An enum indicating the source of voice input, either wake word or push-to-talk.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayController.DismissReason
classes.description: An enum representing reasons for dismissing the overlay.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayController.SendOutcome
classes.description: An enum representing the outcome of sending voice data.

classes.name: VoiceWakeOverlayController.GuardOutcome
classes.description: An enum representing guard outcomes for processing voice data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer for the VoiceWakeOverlayController, sets whether UI is enabled.
